records.quote: At n (Fe3+) = 0.50 and 0.25, we found anomalous dip structures in the n-alpha plot at n approximate to 0.9 and 0.4, respectively.
context_quotes: Based on a spectroscopic investigation, we interpreted the observed dip structures in terms of the transition state between the FeCl4-active and FeL (6)-active regions.
modality_evidence: Based on a spectroscopic investigation, we interpreted the observed dip structures in terms of the transition state between the FeCl4-active and FeL (6)-active regions.
records.note: Species notation 'FeCl4-active' and 'FeL (6)-active' retained; L is undefined.
